# Telangana — local body reservation

*Generated by `make state-readmes`. Edits here are overwritten — change the data or the generator instead.*

**The parsed data for Telangana is in [local_elections_telangana](https://github.com/in-rolls/local_elections_telangana)** — gp_head, gp_ward, 2019, 2025. It was split into its own repository, so it is counted in the [top-level readme](../../README.md) but has no rows here.

Source documents and historical tables are maintained in [local_elections_telangana](https://github.com/in-rolls/local_elections_telangana). This directory keeps no duplicate inputs.

The pooled adapter reads the sibling's declared parsed files into the shared seat and candidate schemas. Files held only in this local source directory do not enter that adapter automatically.

**Pooled outputs:** 24,753 sarpanch seats (2019 and 2025), 49,823 2019 ward seats and 11,464 seat links are standardized.

**Remaining work:** 2025 ward seats are not collected; 2020-21 municipal results are held in the sibling but not parsed.
